subject: ela
cluster: Range of reading and level of text complexity
intro: Read or think about the fact text and pick the answer.

items.prompt:
A fact book 'All About Volcanoes' teaches about:
A) Volcanoes
B) Puppies
C) Cars

steps: Use the title. Key is A.

items.prompt:
Read.

Frogs lay eggs in water.

Where do frogs lay eggs?
A) In trees
B) In water
C) In sand

When we read a fact book together, we should:
A) Listen and look
B) Run around
C) Close our eyes

Read.

Penguins are birds that cannot fly but swim very well.

What can penguins NOT do?
A) Swim
B) Fly
C) Eat

Read.

Honey bees carry pollen from flower to flower.

What do bees carry?
A) Water
B) Pollen
C) Leaves

We read fact books mainly to:
A) Learn real facts
B) Fall asleep
C) Lose the book

steps: Fact books teach. Key is A.

items.prompt:
Read.

The moon has no light of its own. It reflects light from the sun.

Where does the moon's light really come from?
A) The moon itself
B) The sun
C) The stars

steps: 'reflects light from the sun.' Key is B.

items.prompt:
Read.

Camels store fat in their humps to use when food is scarce.

Why do camels store fat?
A) To look big
B) To use when food is scarce
C) To stay cold
items.answer: B) To use when food is scarce

steps: The reason in the text. Key is B.
solution.answer: B) To use when food is scarce
